🚀 NEW on We ❤️ Open Source 🚀

When a single agent loop becomes insufficient, graph-based orchestration offers a way to coordinate specialized agents, conditional routing, shared state, and human checkpoints.

Nihal Kaul examines how LangGraph, AutoGen, and Google ADK approach these challenges, along with the gaps open source developers can help address in multi-agent evaluation, observability, and security.

https://allthingsopen.org/articles/graph-engineering-ai-agents
